# Our World in Data

> Research and data to make progress against the world’s largest problems.

Our World in Data is a research and data publication based at the University of Oxford. It publishes topic pages, interactive charts, data explorers, and methodological articles covering global health, poverty, food, energy, climate, education, population, technology, and many other long-run development trends.

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://ourworldindata.org): Main entry point to research articles, charts, and data on global development.
- [Latest](https://ourworldindata.org/latest): Recently published articles, chart updates, and new research across topics.
- [Charts](https://ourworldindata.org/charts): Searchable library of interactive charts and visualizations from across the site.
- [Data Explorers](https://ourworldindata.org/explorers): Collection of interactive explorers for comparing indicators across countries and time.
- [Data Insights](https://ourworldindata.org/data-insights): Short analytical posts highlighting notable patterns in global data.
- [About](https://ourworldindata.org/about): Overview of the organization, mission, team, and editorial approach.
- [Research and Writing](https://ourworldindata.org/research-and-writing): Explanation of how research, charts, and articles are produced.
- [Contact](https://ourworldindata.org/contact): Contact information for editorial, partnerships, and general inquiries.

## Health

- [Life Expectancy](https://ourworldindata.org/life-expectancy): Long-run trends in life expectancy across countries and regions.
- [Child and Infant Mortality](https://ourworldindata.org/child-mortality): Data on child deaths, causes, and historical declines in mortality.
- [Maternal Mortality](https://ourworldindata.org/maternal-mortality): Global trends and inequalities in deaths related to pregnancy and childbirth.
- [Vaccination](https://ourworldindata.org/vaccination): Coverage, uptake, and impact of vaccines across countries.
- [Malaria](https://ourworldindata.org/malaria): Burden, prevention, treatment, and progress against malaria worldwide.
- [HIV/AIDS](https://ourworldindata.org/hiv-aids): Data on infections, deaths, treatment, and prevention of HIV/AIDS.
- [Cancer](https://ourworldindata.org/cancer): Incidence, mortality, risk factors, and trends in cancer outcomes.
- [Coronavirus Pandemic (COVID-19)](https://ourworldindata.org/coronavirus): Comprehensive COVID-19 data, charts, and pandemic analysis.

## Population & Society

- [Population Growth](https://ourworldindata.org/population-growth): Historical and projected population change around the world.
- [Demography](https://ourworldindata.org/demography): Broad coverage of fertility, mortality, age structure, and population dynamics.
- [Urbanization](https://ourworldindata.org/urbanization): Trends in city growth and the share of people living in urban areas.
- [Migration](https://ourworldindata.org/migration): International migration, refugees, remittances, and migration stocks.
- [Gender Ratio](https://ourworldindata.org/gender-ratio): Sex ratios at birth and across populations over time.
- [Human Height](https://ourworldindata.org/human-height): Historical evidence on height as an indicator of health and living standards.
- [Age Structure](https://ourworldindata.org/age-structure): Population composition by age and implications for societies and economies.

## Poverty, Economy & Inequality

- [Poverty](https://ourworldindata.org/poverty): Global poverty trends, measurement methods, and historical change.
- [Economic Growth](https://ourworldindata.org/economic-growth): Long-run growth in GDP, incomes, and living standards.
- [Income Inequality](https://ourworldindata.org/income-inequality): Distribution of income within and between countries over time.
- [Hunger and Undernourishment](https://ourworldindata.org/hunger-and-undernourishment): Data on food deprivation and progress against hunger.
- [Food Prices](https://ourworldindata.org/food-prices): Trends in food affordability and price changes across markets.
- [Employment in Agriculture](https://ourworldindata.org/employment-in-agriculture): Structural transformation and labor shifts out of agriculture.
- [Working Hours](https://ourworldindata.org/working-hours): Historical changes in hours worked and labor patterns.
- [Taxation](https://ourworldindata.org/taxation): Comparative data on tax revenues and fiscal systems.

## Environment, Climate & Energy

- [CO₂ and Greenhouse Gas Emissions](https://ourworldindata.org/co2-and-greenhouse-gas-emissions): Emissions trends, sources, and international comparisons.
- [Energy](https://ourworldindata.org/energy): Global energy production, consumption, and transitions across sources.
- [Renewable Energy](https://ourworldindata.org/renewable-energy): Deployment and growth of wind, solar, hydro, and other renewables.
- [Fossil Fuels](https://ourworldindata.org/fossil-fuels): Use of coal, oil, and gas in historical and current energy systems.
- [Nuclear Energy](https://ourworldindata.org/nuclear-energy): Electricity generation, safety, and role of nuclear power.
- [Deforestation and Forest Loss](https://ourworldindata.org/deforestation): Forest change, land-use pressures, and regional patterns.
- [Biodiversity](https://ourworldindata.org/biodiversity): Species loss, conservation pressures, and ecological indicators.
- [Plastic Pollution](https://ourworldindata.org/plastic-pollution): Production, waste, and environmental impacts of plastics.

## Food, Agriculture & Land Use

- [Food Supply](https://ourworldindata.org/food-supply): Calories, nutrients, and food availability by country and time.
- [Agricultural Production](https://ourworldindata.org/agricultural-production): Crop and livestock output trends across regions.
- [Land Use](https://ourworldindata.org/land-use): How land is used for farming, forests, settlements, and other purposes.
- [Meat Production](https://ourworldindata.org/meat-production): Global meat output, consumption, and production systems.
- [Seafood Production](https://ourworldindata.org/seafood-production): Aquaculture and wild catch trends in global seafood supply.
- [Pesticides](https://ourworldindata.org/pesticides): Use of pesticides in agriculture and associated trends.
- [Fertilizers](https://ourworldindata.org/fertilizers): Fertilizer use, nutrient inputs, and agricultural intensification.

## Education, Technology & Innovation

- [Global Education](https://ourworldindata.org/global-education): Access, attainment, literacy, and learning outcomes worldwide.
- [Literacy](https://ourworldindata.org/literacy): Historical and global progress in reading and writing skills.
- [Internet](https://ourworldindata.org/internet): Access to and use of the internet across countries.
- [Technological Change](https://ourworldindata.org/technological-change): Long-run patterns in innovation and diffusion of technologies.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://ourworldindata.org/artificial-intelligence): Data and analysis on AI capabilities, adoption, and impacts.
- [Research and Development](https://ourworldindata.org/research-and-development): Spending, intensity, and trends in R&D activity.
- [Patents](https://ourworldindata.org/patents): Patent filings and innovation indicators across countries.

## Politics, Conflict & Human Rights

- [War and Peace](https://ourworldindata.org/war-and-peace): Historical trends in armed conflict, deaths, and peace.
- [Terrorism](https://ourworldindata.org/terrorism): Incidents, fatalities, and patterns in terrorist violence.
- [Democracy](https://ourworldindata.org/democracy): Measures and long-run trends in democratic institutions.
- [Human Rights](https://ourworldindata.org/human-rights): Cross-country indicators on rights protections and abuses.
- [Political Regimes](https://ourworldindata.org/political-regimes): Classification and change in regime types over time.
- [Homicides](https://ourworldindata.org/homicides): Intentional homicide rates and international comparisons.
- [Police Killings](https://ourworldindata.org/police-killings): Data and discussion on deaths caused by law enforcement.

## Data Tools & Methods

- [Our World in Data Grapher](https://ourworldindata.org/grapher): Charting system and data backend used for interactive visualizations.
- [Explorers](https://ourworldindata.org/explorers): Interactive tools for exploring datasets by country, year, and indicator.
- [Charts](https://ourworldindata.org/charts): Direct access to individual charts and downloadable visualizations.
- [Data Catalog](https://ourworldindata.org/data): Entry point for datasets and data-related resources on the site.
- [How We Build Our Charts](https://ourworldindata.org/research-and-writing): Methodological overview of chart production and editorial workflow.
- [Licenses](https://ourworldindata.org/licensing): Terms for reusing charts, articles, and data from the site.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ourworldindata.org/privacy-policy): Information on data collection, cookies, and privacy practices.

## Organization & Support

- [About](https://ourworldindata.org/about): Mission, history, institutional home, and organizational overview.
- [Team](https://ourworldindata.org/team): Staff, researchers, editors, and contributors behind the project.
- [Jobs](https://ourworldindata.org/jobs): Open roles and hiring information for joining the organization.
- [Donate](https://ourworldindata.org/donate): Support the project’s research, data work, and public goods mission.
- [FAQs](https://ourworldindata.org/faqs): Answers to common questions about data, methods, and the organization.
- [Contact](https://ourworldindata.org/contact): Ways to reach the team for media, research, and general questions.
